normalization_plan.reason: The owner parameter only exists to build the permit digest and approve; it has no independent behavior.
The spender parameter is only consumed by permit's digest and _approve call.
The value parameter is only consumed by permit's digest and _approve call.
The deadline parameter is only used for the expiry check and digest inside permit.
The recipient parameter is simply forwarded to the external OOKI.mint call.
The amount parameter is simply forwarded to the external OOKI.mint call.
The address parameter is only used to set the minters mapping entry.
The digest local exists solely as the input to the ecrecover verification.
The recovered address local exists solely for the signer equality check inside permit.
